title: Warm Earthy Irish Pea Eggplant Bake
description: A hearty and earthy Irish dish featuring pea and eggplant, perfect for a chilly evening, this shojin-friendly bake is light and crumbly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the onion until softened.
Add the mushrooms to the skillet and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the diced eggplant to the skillet and cook until it is tender and lightly browned.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked eggplant mixture, thawed peas, diced potato, salt, and black pepper.
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, arrange half of the eggplant mixture in the bottom of the dish.
Sprinkle half of the shredded irish cheddar cheese over the eggplant mixture.
Repeat the layers, starting with the remaining eggplant mixture, then the remaining cheese, and finally the whole wheat breadcrumbs on top.
Bake the dish in the preheated oven for 35 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is hot and bubbly.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
